assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated for extended ambulatory assessment.
The service is medically necessary to support the diagnosed arrhythmias I48.0 and I47.1.
The denial on Reason Code CO-97 is appealed on the basis of documented clinical necessity.
